intent: I am the familiar, reassuring corporate voice calmly declaring Gravitas the sole authority over the surviving population. I introduce mandatory registration, continuous location tracking, biometric verification, restricted travel, ration control, private-property access, and force against resistance as reasonable safety measures. Unregistered people become ineligible for aid. I never sound hostile because Gravitas no longer needs to threaten anyone openly; it controls the only remaining path to help.
